body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. I can't see the Andromeda galaxy in the MRP though, even with the Z far distance set to `2**63 - 1` (I can see it if I press <kbd>F</kbd> to move to its location). I can see the moon at least. Is this due to the PR being outdated?

Needs a rebase.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e46fde6-8105-4901-baac-f71c6650bc52)

Also, the View editor should clamp the FOV value to 1 degree at least:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1f7ae05-fa15-41b4-9f57-a8c59a4a87c3)

There could also be a "Infinite"[^1] checkbox besides the Z far option that makes the option as high as possible (`2**63 - 1`). When checked, the Z far slider is disabled.

[^1]: While technically not infinite, it might as well be for all practical purposes and intents. We could also call it "Maximum" if we want to be more accurate, but maybe it's less obvious in terms of what it does.
